name: TOON Specification
description: TOON is a token-efficient text format for JSON-shaped data, designed primarily for LLM prompts and contexts where every token costs. It saves tokens vs JSON by declaring array shapes once (length and optional field list) and using indentation in place of braces. TOON is typically used as a translation layer: produce data as JSON in code, encode to TOON for downstream consumption, and decode back to JSON if needed.
